summary: Queued changes are easy to see, and the admin screen opens without waiting.

new.title: Choose the admin word in account names
new.text: You can set the word used for admin accounts, for example "adm" instead of "admin".

new.title: New direct groups ask their type
new.text: Creating a direct group asks whether it is a role, organisation, department, process or resource group.

fixes.title: Queued changes show a counter
fixes.text: Pending changes shows a counter that updates at once, and within a minute for changes queued by other admins. Three menu entries for the queue are now one.

fixes.title: Admin list appears at once
fixes.text: Temporary Access Pass status is checked per admin with Check, and Edit sits on the admin's own row.

fixes.title: Passes go to the forwarding address
fixes.text: A Temporary Access Pass is mailed to the admin's forwarding address, not their manager. Values that are not email addresses are refused.
